scope: First-party historical teaching-channel leads; neither a new teaching-recording count nor evidence of surviving audio

records.title: Temple Emanu-El Tucson adult class podcast account
teaching_context: Basic and Intermediate Judaism combined session on Jewish Music with Rabbi Samuel M. Cohon (May 1, 2013)
Zohar, Soul-Text of Kabbalah with Rabbi Samuel M. Cohon (scheduled through May 16, 2013)
records.source_statement: The newsletter says podcasts of classes are available and points to this historical Podbean account.
records.evidence_boundary: The newsletter does not establish that every named class was individually recorded or that any episode remains playable. This is a recovery lead, not a new verified recording.
records.observed_access_result: Historical Podbean channel redirects to a login URL with error=Invalid Podbean Site(2) in public web inspection; provider error is not permanent proof every old media file is lost.
records.next_steps: Search independent first-party playlists, archived RSS/enclosure listings and any user-controlled backup. If a specific media URL emerges, test it separately and verify audio bytes/checksum before classifying it as recovered.

rss_checks.result: Both public RSS endpoint fetches failed as inaccessible through current research browser; no episode IDs, RSS item GUIDs or enclosure URLs were obtained.
rss_checks.interpretation: Endpoint failures do not prove all historic RSS items or audio are irrecoverable.

records.title: Temple Emanu-El Tucson music and service recording practice (as of 2012)
records.publisher: Rabbi Samuel M. Cohon, first-person letter published by Arizona Jewish Post
records.source_statement: In a signed letter, Rabbi Cohon describes Temple Emanu-El's substantial music (and recording) associated with High Holy Days, festivals and Shabbat.
records.evidence_boundary: This source verifies a historical recording practice in general. It does not identify a particular recording of Cohon, a master, an episode, a direct audio link, a checksum, or ownership.
records.next_steps: Search legitimate Temple recording inventories and old public music archives for concrete titles, dates and original media IDs; do not infer individual surviving audio.

records.title: Hearing Voices episode 009: Shoah — For Holocaust Remembrance Day
records.source_statement: Publisher episode 009's index identifies Rabbi Samuel Cohon of Temple Emanu-El, Tucson and Too Jewish Radio as the presenter of an episode of Holocaust survivor stories.
records.publisher_episode_url_result: Referenced by 'Listen' link in publisher's original catalogue, but the individual detail page did not load in the October 22 research browser. No direct playable media URL extracted.
records.evidence_boundary: Specific episode ID and claimed program presentation are confirmed from primary publisher metadata, but no episode file or recording of Cohon's voice was downloaded or listened to. Do not count as recovered audio or as 2008 Too Jewish show, and do not infer any 2013 Temple class audio.
records.next_steps: Use a readable first-party Hearing Voices episode page or authorized source archive to recover concrete audio enclosure and verify bytes/voice; no outreach authorized.

index_recheck.program_description: Rabbi Samuel Cohon of Temple Emanuel, Tucson and Too Jewish Radio presents a themed collection of Holocaust survivor stories.
publisher_listed_components: Descended from the Holocaust — Dr. Alan Berkenwald, Life Stories audio diary
Yom Hashoah 1994 — Billings/Cleveland services, interviews and response to antisemitic crimes
Voices of the Shoah — excerpts from Rhino Records testimony project
Belsen Concentration Camp — Patrick Gordon Walker BBC recording from May 1945
index_recheck.component_authorship_boundary: The series credits constituent audio diaries, old broadcast reports and documentary excerpts to other producers. Publisher description does not identify a standalone Cohon source recording or establish rights to those constituent works.
index_recheck.result: Publisher series index accessible and identifies full episode metadata. The detail page and alternate entry/feed links returned cache miss or were inaccessible. Direct media enclosure, GUID, checksum, runtime, playback and Cohon voice confirmation remain unavailable.
index_recheck.archived_replay_attempt: https://web.archive.org/web/20080501000000/http://hearingvoices.com/2008/04/hv009-shoah/ was inaccessible; no claim is made about whether the Wayback collection contains snapshots.
